id: title:MattPua:remove redundant text from slack reports

review.posthog_relevance: Changes Slack notification payload for subscription delivery, potentially affecting user perception of subscription status and delivery frequency.
review.reason: The change removes subscription summary context from Slack message titles and headers while retaining delivery schedules and images, and adds a conditional check for dashboard IDs. This is a localized maintenance and behavior correction within the Slack integration, not a systemic capability or critical reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual impact on user perception and delivery frequency is not demonstrated by the code; this is a conjectured benefit. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.
